[sync](chore) Sync main from branch main-dev (#2944)

* [ssbuffer](feat) Plan vector block handle for/if (#2909)

Co-authored-by: shaoyiyang <shaoyiyang1@huawei.com>

* [ssbuffer] (feat) mne adapter for/if (#2004)

Co-authored-by: shaoyiyang <shaoyiyang1@huawei.com>

* [ascend](feat) add TLA SIMD unary and fused arithmetic ops (#2923)

* [ascend](feat) add TLA SIMD unary and fused arithmetic ops

Add vabs, vnot, vrelu, vabsdif and vexpdif interfaces, upgrade vneg/vsqrt with mask/mode support, and add dtype/mask/tail coverage under tla_ut/simd. Keep vexpdif f32 as the validated contract and omit the expdif alias.

* [ascend](style) format TLA SIMD tests

Apply the repository yapf configuration to the new TLA SIMD test files and frontend contract tests.

---------

Co-authored-by: xiwei <xiwei4@huawei.com>

* [TLA](feat) Add subviews and mmad transpose-a (#2924)

* [Triton][TLA] feat: extend MMAD and buffer views

Motivation: Attention kernels need transpose-A MMAD and bounded actual
tile extents, while compact tail buffers need a general aliasing view
that preserves offsets through reshapes.

Design: Forward transpose-A to HIVM, validate actual MMAD dimensions,
and expose rank-preserving memref subviews. Preserve source offsets in
contiguous reshape result types. Add three-stage TLA unit tests and
frontend contract coverage with focused API documentation.

Risks: Non-square transpose-B calls now validate transposed dimensions.
Actual extents require a matching compact L0C accumulator. Dynamic
subview offsets remain the caller's responsibility to keep in bounds.

Assisted-by: AI

* [Ascend](docs) document TLA DMA and Cube interfaces

Document parameter types, layouts, defaults and current restrictions for the assigned DMA, allocation, MMAD and CTRL interfaces. Include their immutable parameter configurations without changing executable behavior.

* [Ascend](fix) synchronize TLA Fixpipe test writeback

Wait for Cube-produced UB data before Vector writeback: use PIPE.F after Fixpipe and PIPE.MTE1 after L12UB. Restrict the single-target UB store to sub-block 0 while both AIVs join the block handshake.

Check the handoff in lowered IR and validate all twelve configurations with three random seeds. The unmodified test reproduces four accuracy failures; the corrected test passes all 36 IR, compilation and runtime checks on Ascend950 with the existing main-dev wheel.

* [Ascend](fix) scope DMA load-store tests to Vector cores

Wrap load/store DMA operations in an explicit Vector scope so the current A5 backend can identify and lower the pure AIV module. Assert the Vector scope marker in the lowered IR.

Restore PadNull and atomic ADD/MAX/MIN accuracy checks, which pass exactly with the current main-dev wheel. Report the two remaining nonempty-padding cases with pytest.skip rather than returning and counting unexecuted checks as passed. Full DMA validation: 97 passed, 2 skipped; direct padding probes still reproduce incorrect output.

* [Ascend](test) promote Cube GEMM v2 tests

Replace the legacy gemm_basic and gemm_bias tests with their explicit DMA implementations. Remove the v2 files and rename kernel symbols and output labels while preserving IR, binary compilation and accuracy checks.

* [ascend](feat) TLA: add 16 Vec-SIMD affinity interfaces

First batch of tla.simd Vec-SIMD affinity interfaces with builder
support and tla_ut 3-in-1 precision tests:

  vand, vmuls, vmula, vmadd, vaxpy, vln,
  pand, por, pxor, pnot, psel, vcmps, tail_mask, vmull, pset, vcvt

Details:
- tla_builder.cc: new create_simd_preg_binary/create_simd_preg_unary
  (ave.hir.preg.and/or/xor/not), create_simd_vmull (ave.hir.mull),
  "and"/"ln" kinds for the generic binary/unary dispatchers, and a
  vcvt rework covering s2f/u2f/f2s/f2u with the ISA part/rnd/sat
  attribute rules from the op verifiers.
- builder.py: allowlist the three new builder methods for the unified
  builder.
- simd.py: the interfaces plus PAT/ROUND/PART enums; vaxpy composes an
  unmasked vmuls followed by a masked vadd, tail_mask composes
  vci(0) ULT broadcast(value), psel reuses the i1 vsel path, pset
  exposes the full ave.hir.pge pattern set.
- unittest/tla_ut/simd/: 16 test files following the 3-in-1 convention
  (IR assertions, compile artifacts, NPU numerics against torch
  references), 45 tests in total.

Verified: a full tla_ut/simd pytest run shows zero regressions against
the dev daily baseline (the 22 pre-existing failures are identical
with and without this change and are tracked separately).

+Inputs may use logical 2-D shapes or physical 4-D NZ shapes. Transposition

+    :param a: L1 left operand with logical shape ``(M, K)``, or ``(K, M)``
+        when ``transpose_a=True``.
+    :type a: tla.buffer
+    :param b: L1 right operand with logical shape ``(K, N)``, or ``(N, K)``
+        when ``transpose_b=True``, and the same element type as ``a``.
+    :type b: tla.buffer
+    :param acc: L0C accumulator with logical shape ``(real_m, real_n)``. Its
+        element type must be a backend-supported accumulator type for ``a``
+        and ``b``.
+    :type acc: tla.buffer
+    :param transpose_a: Compile-time native A-transpose flag. Defaults to
+        ``False``. The transpose is carried by MMAD rather than a separate
+        data movement, and the frontend swaps the two logical dimensions of
+        ``a`` when validating the product.
+    :type transpose_a: bool

+        the attribute unset (default). ``DISABLED`` (0),
+        ``ENABLED_WITHOUT_UPDATE`` (2) and ``ENABLED_WITH_UPDATE`` (3) select
+        explicit modes. Value 1 is reserved.
+    :type unit_flag_ctrl: tla.UnitFlagMode, int or None
+    :param unit_flag_group_id: Keyword-only compile-time signed 64-bit group
+        ID, or ``None`` to leave it unset. Match the related Fixpipe protocol;
+        valid hardware IDs are backend-dependent.
+    :type unit_flag_group_id: int or None

+        full ``M``. Must be a positive compile-time multiple of 16 that does
+        not exceed ``M``.
+    :type real_m: int or None
+    :param real_k: Actual K extent to compute, or ``None`` (default) for the
+        full ``K``. Must be a positive compile-time multiple of 16 that does
+        not exceed ``K``.
+    :type real_k: int or None

+// RUN: triton-opt %s --ssbuffer-split-matmul --verify-each | FileCheck %s
+// RUN: triton-opt %s --ssbuf-standardize-op --verify-each > /dev/null
+
+// Supply the MNE handoff normally emitted by PatternMatchRewritePass so the
+// standalone split pass runs without changing its production entry condition.
+
+// A/B edges are omitted from grouping, but the intermediate result is still
+// observed as A. Removing its bias across the pair would change multiplication.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @intermediate_used_as_a_and_c
+// CHECK: %[[RAW0:.*]] = linalg.matmul
+// CHECK: %[[SUM0:.*]] = arith.addf %[[RAW0]], %arg2
+// CHECK: %[[RAW1:.*]] = linalg.matmul {{.*}}ins(%[[SUM0]], %arg1
+// CHECK: %[[SUM1:.*]] = arith.addf %[[RAW1]], %[[SUM0]]
+// CHECK: return %[[SUM1]]
+func.func @intermediate_used_as_a_and_c(%a: tensor<4x4xf32>, %b: tensor<4x4xf32>, %c: tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+  %x = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%a, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%c : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+  %y = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%x, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%x : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+  return %y : tensor<4x4xf32>
+}
+
+// A-only dependency is outside the accumulator chain. Both matmuls split
+// independently, and the second one observes the first one's restored result.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @a_only_dependency
+// CHECK: %[[RAW0:.*]] = linalg.matmul
+// CHECK: %[[SUM0:.*]] = arith.addf %[[RAW0]], %arg2
+// CHECK: %[[RAW1:.*]] = linalg.matmul {{.*}}ins(%[[SUM0]], %arg1
+// CHECK: %[[SUM1:.*]] = arith.addf %[[RAW1]], %arg3
+// CHECK: return %[[SUM1]]
+func.func @a_only_dependency(%a: tensor<4x4xf32>, %b: tensor<4x4xf32>, %c: tensor<4x4xf32>, %d: tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+  %x = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%a, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%c : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+  %y = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%x, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%d : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+  return %y : tensor<4x4xf32>
+}
+
+// An accumulator observed as A must retain the original loop recurrence.
+// Split only the matmul C operand and restore its bias inside the loop.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @loop_accumulator_used_as_a
+// CHECK: %[[LOOP:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = scf.for {{.*}}iter_args(%[[ACC:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = %arg1)
+// CHECK: %[[ZERO:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = linalg.fill
+// CHECK: %[[RAW:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = linalg.matmul {{.*}}ins(%[[ACC]], %arg0
+// CHECK-SAME: outs(%[[ZERO]]
+// CHECK: %[[SUM:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = arith.addf %[[RAW]], %[[ACC]]
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[SUM]]
+// CHECK-NOT: memref.load
+// CHECK-NOT: arith.addf
+// CHECK: return %[[LOOP]]
+
+func.func @loop_accumulator_used_as_a(%b: tensor<4x4xf32>, %c: tensor<4x4xf32>, %n: index) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+  %lb = arith.constant 0 : index
+  %step = arith.constant 1 : index
+  %r = scf.for %i = %lb to %n step %step iter_args(%acc = %c) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+    %m = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%acc, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%acc : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>

+// RUN: triton-opt %s --ssbuf-standardize-op --verify-each > /dev/null
+
+// Supply the MNE handoff normally emitted by PatternMatchRewritePass so the
+// standalone split pass runs without changing its production entry condition.
+
+// The same C entering two different component-side Phi nodes is two entries.
+// Reject the maximal component for residency and preserve both original paths.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @reset_to_initial_c
+// CHECK: %[[LOOP:.*]] = scf.for {{.*}}iter_args(%[[ACC:.*]] = %arg2)
+// CHECK: scf.if
+// CHECK: %[[ZERO:.*]] = linalg.fill

+// CHECK: %[[SUM:.*]] = arith.addf %[[MM]], %[[ACC]]
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[SUM]]
+// CHECK: } else {
+// CHECK: scf.yield %arg2
+// CHECK-NOT: memref.load
+// CHECK: return %[[LOOP]]
+func.func @reset_to_initial_c(%a: tensor<4x4xf32>, %b: tensor<4x4xf32>, %c: tensor<4x4xf32>, %go: i1, %n: index) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+  %lb = arith.constant 0 : index
+  %step = arith.constant 1 : index
+  %r = scf.for %i = %lb to %n step %step iter_args(%acc = %c) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+    %x = scf.if %go -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+      %m = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%a, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%acc : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+      scf.yield %m : tensor<4x4xf32>
+    } else {
+      scf.yield %c : tensor<4x4xf32>
+    }
+    scf.yield %x : tensor<4x4xf32>
+  }
+  return %r : tensor<4x4xf32>
+}
+
+// The predicate Phi is not strongly connected to the tensor accumulator.
+// Only the C ring belongs to this SCC; its before index 0 maps to result 1.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @while_permuted_result
+// CHECK: %[[LOOP:.*]]:2 = scf.while
+// CHECK: scf.condition
+// CHECK: linalg.matmul
+// CHECK: memref.store
+// CHECK: memref.load

+// CHECK: } else {
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[LOOP]]#1
+// CHECK: arith.addf %[[GUARD]], %arg2
+
+func.func @while_permuted_result(%a: tensor<4x4xf32>, %b: tensor<4x4xf32>, %c: tensor<4x4xf32>, %go: i1) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
+  %r:2 = scf.while (%acc = %c, %p = %go) : (tensor<4x4xf32>, i1) -> (i1, tensor<4x4xf32>) {
+    scf.condition(%p) %p, %acc : i1, tensor<4x4xf32>

+  ^bb0(%again: i1, %arg: tensor<4x4xf32>):
+    %m = linalg.matmul {ssbuffer.may_not_exec} ins(%a, %b : tensor<4x4xf32>, tensor<4x4xf32>) outs(%arg : tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+    %stop = arith.constant false
+    scf.yield %m, %stop : tensor<4x4xf32>, i1
+  }
+  return %r#1 : tensor<4x4xf32>

+// CHECK: %[[SKIP_FILL:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = linalg.fill ins(%[[SKIP_ZERO]] : f32) outs(%[[SKIP_EMPTY]] : tensor<4x4xf32>)
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[SKIP_FILL]]
+// CHECK: } else {

+// CHECK: arith.addf %[[GUARD]], %arg2

+// CHECK-NOT: arith.addf

+"""Shared helpers for the extended SIMD unary/binary tests."""
+import torch
+import triton.language as tl
+
+MASK_ROWS = 6
+TAIL_BASE = MASK_ROWS
+MASK_ROWS_C = tl.constexpr(MASK_ROWS)
+TAIL_BASE_C = tl.constexpr(TAIL_BASE)
+
+
+def masks(n, active):
+    idx = torch.arange(n)
+    thr = (torch.arange(n) % 5) * (n // 5)
+    return {"prefix": idx < active, "arb": idx < thr, "none": torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.bool)}, thr
+
+
+def apply(value, mask):
+    return torch.where(mask, value, torch.zeros((), dtype=value.dtype))
+
+
+def ref_rows(value, mask_set):
+    return torch.stack([
+        value,
+        apply(value, mask_set["prefix"]),
+        apply(value, mask_set["arb"]),
+        apply(value, mask_set["none"]),
+        apply(value, mask_set["prefix"]),
+        apply(value, mask_set["arb"]),
+    ])
+
+
+def inactive_zero(got, mask_set):
+    for row, name in ((1, "prefix"), (2, "arb"), (3, "none"), (4, "prefix"), (5, "arb")):
+        keep = mask_set[name]
+        inactive = got[row][~keep] if keep.any() else got[row]
+        assert (inactive == 0).all(), f"row {row} ({name}) has a non-zero inactive lane"
+
+
+def padded_unary(op, x, tiles, lanes, total, sentinel, dtype=None):
+    out = torch.full((tiles, lanes), sentinel, dtype=dtype or x.dtype)
+    for t in range(tiles):
+        if t == tiles - 1:
+            n = total - (tiles - 1) * lanes
+            out[t, :n] = op(x[t][:n])
+        else:
+            out[t] = op(x[t])
+    return out
+
+
+def padded_binary(op, x, y, tiles, lanes, total, sentinel, dtype=None):
+    out = torch.full((tiles, lanes), sentinel, dtype=dtype or x.dtype)
+    for t in range(tiles):
+        if t == tiles - 1:
+            n = total - (tiles - 1) * lanes
+            out[t, :n] = op(x[t][:n], y[t][:n])
+        else:
+            out[t] = op(x[t], y[t])
+    return out

+"""TLA 3-in-1 test: pand (predicate AND) exact bits on i1 registers.
+
+Predicates are built with vcmp over u32 data and materialized to u32
+0/1 lanes through vsel before storing.
+
+Stages: ir (offline HIVM), compile (kernel artifacts), run (numerics).
+Rows: 0 full-mask, 1 prefix-gated, 2 all-false-gated.
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+import triton.language.extra.tla as tla
+from utils.tla_test_utils import (get_stages, compile_offline, lower_offline, check_lowered_ir, check_compile_artifacts)
+
+SHAPE = dict(lanes=64, active=32)
+SIGNATURE = {"X": "*u32", "T1": "*u32", "T2": "*u32", "O": "*u32"}
+
+
+@tla.jit
+def pand(X, T1, T2, O, N: tl.constexpr, ACTIVE: tl.constexpr):
+    x = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.uint32, space="ub")
+    t1 = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.uint32, space="ub")
+    t2 = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.uint32, space="ub")
+    o = tla.alloc_buffer((3, N), tl.uint32, space="ub")
+    tla.copy(tla.view(X, (N, )), x)
+    tla.copy(tla.view(T1, (N, )), t1)
+    tla.copy(tla.view(T2, (N, )), t2)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        xv = tla.simd.vlds(x[0])
+        a = tla.simd.vlds(t1[0])
+        b = tla.simd.vlds(t2[0])
+        p1 = tla.simd.vcmp(xv, a, op=tla.simd.CMP.LT)
+        p2 = tla.simd.vcmp(xv, b, op=tla.simd.CMP.GT)
+        idx = tla.simd.vci(0)
+        prefix = tla.simd.pge(ACTIVE, N)
+        none = tla.simd.vcmp(idx, idx, op=tla.simd.CMP.NE)
+        ones = tla.simd.vsplat(1, tl.uint32)
+        zeros = tla.simd.vsplat(0, tl.uint32)
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[0, 0], tla.simd.vsel(tla.simd.pand(p1, p2), ones, zeros))
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[1, 0], tla.simd.vsel(tla.simd.pand(p1, p2, prefix), ones, zeros))
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[2, 0], tla.simd.vsel(tla.simd.pand(p1, p2, none), ones, zeros))
+    tla.copy(o, tla.view(O, (3, N)))
+
+
+def constexprs():
+    return {"N": SHAPE["lanes"], "ACTIVE": SHAPE["active"]}
+
+
+def test_ir(output_dir=None):
+    module, ctx = compile_offline(pand, SIGNATURE, constexprs(), output_dir=output_dir)
+    text = str(module)
+    assert text.count("ave.hir.preg.and") == 3
+    assert text.count("ave.hir.vsel") == 3, "one materializing vsel per row"
+    text = str(lower_offline(module, ctx, output_dir=output_dir))
+    check_lowered_ir(text, loads=3, stores=1, buffers=None, extra=("ave.hir.preg.and", ))
+    print("IR PASS: pand full/prefix/all-false gating")
+
+
+def _launch():
+    s = SHAPE
+    x = torch.randint(0, 1 << 32, (s["lanes"], ), dtype=torch.int64)
+    t1 = torch.randint(0, 1 << 32, (s["lanes"], ), dtype=torch.int64)
+    t2 = torch.randint(0, 1 << 32, (s["lanes"], ), dtype=torch.int64)
+    out = torch.empty((3, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.uint32, device="npu")
+    pand[(1, )](x.to(torch.uint32).to("npu"), t1.to(torch.uint32).to("npu"), t2.to(torch.uint32).to("npu"), out,
+                **constexprs())
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    p = (x < t1) & (x > t2)
+    ref = torch.zeros((3, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.int64)
+    ref[0] = p.to(torch.int64)
+    ref[1, :s["active"]] = p[:s["active"]].to(torch.int64)
+    return out, ref.to(torch.uint32)
+
+
+def test_compile():
+    _launch()
+    artifacts = check_compile_artifacts()
+    assert artifacts, "no .o/.npubin artifact in TRITON_CACHE_DIR"
+    print("COMPILE PASS: pand generated artifacts", len(artifacts), "->", artifacts[0])
+
+
+def test_run():
+    out, ref = _launch()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.cpu().view(torch.int32), ref.view(torch.int32), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    print("PAND OK: predicate AND exact bits")
+
+
+def main():
+    do_ir, do_compile, do_run = get_stages()
+    if do_ir:
+        test_ir()
+    if do_compile:
+        test_compile()
+    if do_run:
+        test_run()
+    print("ALL PASS: pand", "ir" if do_ir else "", "compile/run" if do_run else "compile" if do_compile else "")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def vcmps(X, Y, O, N: tl.constexpr, ACTIVE: tl.constexpr):

+    y = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.int32, space="ub")

+        yv = tla.simd.vlds(y[0])
+        prefix = tla.simd.pge(ACTIVE, N)
+        ones = tla.simd.vsplat(1, tl.uint32)
+        zeros = tla.simd.vsplat(0, tl.uint32)
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[0, 0], tla.simd.vsel(tla.simd.vcmps(xv, 0x80000000, op=tla.simd.CMP.ULT), ones, zeros))

+    tla.copy(o, tla.view(O, (3, N)))

+"""TLA 3-in-1 test: vcvt dtype conversions with masks, rounding and sat.
+
+Two kernels: signed int->fp (vsitofp, i32->f32) and fp->int (vfptosi,
+f32->i32 with round/sat/mask).  Inputs stay within the f32-exact range
+(|x| < 2**24) so the references are exact.
+
+The unsigned directions (vuitofp u8->f16 / u64->f32, vfptoui f16->u8) are
+implemented in the builder but their part->lane mapping needs ISA-doc
+confirmation, so they are not numerically exercised here yet.
+
+Stages: ir (offline HIVM), compile (kernel artifacts), run (numerics).
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+import triton.language.extra.tla as tla
+from utils.tla_test_utils import (get_stages, compile_offline, lower_offline, check_lowered_ir, check_compile_artifacts)
+
+SHAPE = dict(lanes=64, active=32)
+SIGNATURE_I2F = {"X": "*i32", "OF": "*fp32"}
+SIGNATURE_F2I = {"XF": "*fp32", "OI": "*i32"}
+
+
+@tla.jit
+def vcvt_i2f(X, OF, N: tl.constexpr, ACTIVE: tl.constexpr):
+    x = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.int32, space="ub")
+    o = tla.alloc_buffer((2, N), tl.float32, space="ub")
+    tla.copy(tla.view(X, (N, )), x)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        xv = tla.simd.vlds(x[0])
+        prefix = tla.simd.pge(ACTIVE, N)
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[0, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(xv, tl.float32))
+        tla.simd.vsts(o[1, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(xv, tl.float32, prefix))
+    tla.copy(o, tla.view(OF, (2, N)))
+
+
+@tla.jit
+def vcvt_f2i(XF, OI, N: tl.constexpr, ACTIVE: tl.constexpr):
+    xf = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.float32, space="ub")
+    oi = tla.alloc_buffer((4, N), tl.int32, space="ub")
+    tla.copy(tla.view(XF, (N, )), xf)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        f = tla.simd.vlds(xf[0])
+        prefix = tla.simd.pge(ACTIVE, N)
+        # f2s with default round=R (ties to even)
+        tla.simd.vsts(oi[0, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(f, tl.int32))
+        # f2s with round=Z (toward zero)
+        tla.simd.vsts(oi[1, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(f, tl.int32, round=tla.simd.ROUND.Z))
+        # f2s with sat=True saturates an overflowing row
+        tla.simd.vsts(oi[2, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(tla.simd.vmuls(f, 1e9), tl.int32, sat=True))
+        # masked f2s ZEROING
+        tla.simd.vsts(oi[3, 0], tla.simd.vcvt(f, tl.int32, prefix))
+    tla.copy(oi, tla.view(OI, (4, N)))
+
+
+def constexprs():
+    return {"N": SHAPE["lanes"], "ACTIVE": SHAPE["active"]}
+
+
+def test_ir(output_dir=None):
+    module, ctx = compile_offline(vcvt_i2f, SIGNATURE_I2F, constexprs(), output_dir=output_dir)
+    text = str(module)
+    assert text.count("ave.hir.vsitofp") == 2
+    assert "ave.hir.pge <VL32>" in text
+    text = str(lower_offline(module, ctx, output_dir=output_dir))
+    check_lowered_ir(text, loads=1, stores=1, buffers=None, extra=("ave.hir.vsitofp", ))
+
+    module, ctx = compile_offline(vcvt_f2i, SIGNATURE_F2I, constexprs())
+    text = str(module)
+    assert text.count("ave.hir.vfptosi") == 4
+    text = str(lower_offline(module, ctx))
+    check_lowered_ir(text, loads=1, stores=1, buffers=None, extra=("ave.hir.vfptosi", ))
+    print("IR PASS: vcvt s2f/f2i round/sat/mask variants")
+
+
+def _launch():
+    s = SHAPE
+    x = torch.randint(-(1 << 24), 1 << 24, (s["lanes"], ), dtype=torch.int64).to(torch.int32)
+    of = torch.empty((2, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    vcvt_i2f[(1, )](x.to("npu"), of, **constexprs())
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    ref = torch.zeros((2, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.float32)
+    ref[0] = x.to(torch.float32)
+    ref[1, :s["active"]] = x[:s["active"]].to(torch.float32)
+
+    # f32 rounding kernel with tie-heavy values
+    base = torch.arange(s["lanes"], dtype=torch.float32) * 0.5 - 8.0
+    xf = base + torch.where(torch.arange(s["lanes"]) % 2 == 0, 0.25, -0.25)
+    oi = torch.empty((4, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")
+    vcvt_f2i[(1, )](xf.to("npu"), oi, **constexprs())
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    floor = torch.floor(xf)
+    ties_even = torch.where(floor + 0.5 == xf, floor + (floor % 2), torch.round(xf))
+    ref2 = torch.zeros((4, s["lanes"]), dtype=torch.int64)
+    ref2[0] = ties_even.to(torch.int64)
+    ref2[1] = torch.trunc(xf).to(torch.int64)
+    ref2[2] = (xf.double() * 1e9).clamp(-(2**31), 2**31 - 1).to(torch.int64)
+    ref2[3, :s["active"]] = ties_even[:s["active"]].to(torch.int64)
+    return (of, oi), (ref, ref2)
+
+
+def test_compile():
+    _launch()

+
+Rows 0..5 use one full register with default / prefix / arbitrary / all-false
+masks plus ZEROING / MERGING. Rows 6.. are three tiled registers; the last tile
+is 8/64 lanes and its masked store keeps the sentinel padding.
+
+Stages: ir (offline HIVM), compile (kernel artifacts), run (numerics).

+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

+from _simd_ext_common import MASK_ROWS, TAIL_BASE, MASK_ROWS_C, TAIL_BASE_C, masks, ref_rows, inactive_zero, padded_binary
+from utils.tla_test_utils import (get_stages, compile_offline, lower_offline, check_lowered_ir, check_compile_artifacts)
+
+SHAPE = dict(lanes=64, active=32, tiles=3, total=136)
+SHAPE["tail"] = SHAPE["total"] - (SHAPE["tiles"] - 1) * SHAPE["lanes"]
+SHAPE["rows"] = MASK_ROWS + SHAPE["tiles"]
+SENTINEL_F = -123.0
+SENTINEL_FC = tl.constexpr(SENTINEL_F)
+SIGNATURE = {"X": "*fp32", "Y": "*fp32", "T": "*i32", "O": "*fp32"}
+
+
+@tla.jit
+def vexpdif_f32(X, Y, T, O, N: tl.constexpr, ACTIVE: tl.constexpr, TILES: tl.constexpr, TAIL: tl.constexpr):
+    xb = tla.alloc_buffer((TILES, N), tl.float32, space="ub")
+    yb = tla.alloc_buffer((TILES, N), tl.float32, space="ub")
+    tb = tla.alloc_buffer((N, ), tl.int32, space="ub")
+    ob = tla.alloc_buffer((MASK_ROWS_C + TILES, N), tl.float32, space="ub")
+    tla.copy(tla.view(X, (TILES, N)), xb)
+    tla.copy(tla.view(Y, (TILES, N)), yb)
+    tla.copy(tla.view(T, (N, )), tb)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        x = tla.simd.vlds(xb[0, 0])
+        y = tla.simd.vlds(yb[0, 0])
+        t = tla.simd.vlds(tb[0])
+        idx = tla.simd.vci(0)
+        prefix = tla.simd.pge(ACTIVE, N)
+        arb = tla.simd.vcmp(idx, t, op=tla.simd.CMP.LT)
+        none = tla.simd.vcmp(idx, idx, op=tla.simd.CMP.NE)
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[0, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[1, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y, mask=prefix))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[2, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y, mask=arb))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[3, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y, mask=none))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[4, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y, mask=prefix, mode=tla.simd.MODE.MERGING))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[5, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(x, y, mask=arb, mode=tla.simd.MODE.MERGING))
+        tla.simd.vsts(ob[TAIL_BASE_C + TILES - 1, 0], tla.simd.vsplat(SENTINEL_FC, tl.float32))
+        for tile in tl.static_range(TILES):
+            vx = tla.simd.vlds(xb[tile, 0])
+            vy = tla.simd.vlds(yb[tile, 0])
+            if tile == TILES - 1:
+                tail_mask = tla.simd.pge(TAIL, N)
+                tla.simd.vsts(ob[TAIL_BASE_C + tile, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(vx, vy, mask=tail_mask), mask=tail_mask)
+            else:
+                tla.simd.vsts(ob[TAIL_BASE_C + tile, 0], tla.simd.vexpdif(vx, vy))
+    tla.copy(ob, tla.view(O, (MASK_ROWS_C + TILES, N)))
+
+
+def constexprs():
+    return {"N": SHAPE["lanes"], "ACTIVE": SHAPE["active"], "TILES": SHAPE["tiles"], "TAIL": SHAPE["tail"]}

+    assert text.count("ave.hir.vsel") == 2, "two MERGING rows add vsel"
+    assert "ave.hir.pge <VL32>" in text
+    assert "ave.hir.pge <VL8>" in text, "tail predicate must select 8 lanes"
+    text = str(lower_offline(module, ctx, output_dir=output_dir))
+    check_lowered_ir(text, loads=3, stores=1, buffers=None, extra=("ave.hir.vexpdif", ))
+    print("IR PASS: vexpdif f32 six masks plus 2 full + 1 tail tile")
+
+
+def _launch():
+    s = SHAPE
+    x = torch.randn((s["tiles"], s["lanes"])) * 0.5
+    y = torch.randn((s["tiles"], s["lanes"])) * 0.5

+    torch.testing.assert_close(got, ref, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
+    inactive_zero(got, mask_set)

+"""Subview/reshape composition: IR, compilation and exact device alias checks.
+
+The compact case mirrors FA's (8, 2064) allocation and (8, 1040) prefix.
+All cases write through the alias and read both the alias and the complete
+allocation, so preserved offsets, row pitches and untouched guards are checked.
+"""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+import torch
+import triton.language as tl
+import triton.language.extra.tla as tla
+
+from utils.tla_test_utils import get_stages, compile_offline, lower_offline, check_kernel_binary, matrix
+
+CONFIGS = [
+    dict(name=f"{dtype}_{mode}", dtype=dtype, mode=mode)
+    for dtype in ("fp16", "bf16")
+    for mode in ("prefix", "static_offset", "dynamic_offset", "nested_offset", "pitched")
+]
+DTYPES = {"fp16": (tl.float16, torch.float16), "bf16": (tl.bfloat16, torch.bfloat16)}
+
+
+def constants(case):
+    return dict(DTYPE=DTYPES[case["dtype"]][0], MODE=case["mode"])
+
+
+def signature(case):
+    return {
+        "X": "*" + case["dtype"], "Y": "*" + case["dtype"], "O": "*" + case["dtype"], "Backing": "*" + case["dtype"],
+        "offset": "i32"
+    }
+
+
+@tla.jit
+def subview_alias(X, Y, O, Backing, offset, DTYPE: tl.constexpr, MODE: tl.constexpr):
+    with tla.scope.vector():
+        root = tla.alloc((8, 2064), DTYPE, space="ub")
+        tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(X, (8, 2064)), root)
+        if MODE == "pitched":
+            tile = tla.subview(root, offsets=(0, 0), sizes=(8, 1040))
+        else:
+            flat = tla.reshape(root, (16512, ))
+            if MODE == "nested_offset":
+                window = tla.subview(flat, offsets=(offset, ), sizes=(8448, ))
+                prefix = tla.subview(window, offsets=(128, ), sizes=(8320, ))
+            elif MODE == "dynamic_offset":
+                prefix = tla.subview(flat, offsets=(offset, ), sizes=(8320, ))
+            elif MODE == "static_offset":
+                prefix = tla.subview(flat, offsets=(128, ), sizes=(8320, ))
+            else:
+                prefix = tla.subview(flat, offsets=(0, ), sizes=(8320, ))
+            tile = tla.reshape(prefix, (8, 1040))
+        tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(Y, (8, 1040)), tile)
+        tla.store_ub_to_gm(tile, tla.view(O, (8, 1040)))
+        tla.store_ub_to_gm(root, tla.view(Backing, (8, 2064)))
+
+
+@matrix(CONFIGS)
+def test_ir(case, output_dir=None):
+    module, ctx = compile_offline(subview_alias, signature(case), constants(case), output_dir=output_dir)
+    ast = str(module)
+    assert "memref.subview" in ast
+    assert ast.count("memref.alloc()") == 1, "views must share the original allocation"
+    if case["mode"] != "pitched":
+        assert "memref.collapse_shape" in ast and "memref.expand_shape" in ast
+        assert "strided<[1040, 1], offset: ?>" in ast
+    else:
+        assert "memref.expand_shape" not in ast
+        assert "strided<[2064, 1], offset: ?>" in ast
+    if case["mode"] == "nested_offset":
+        assert ast.count("memref.subview") == 2
+    text = str(lower_offline(module, ctx, output_dir=output_dir))
+    assert text.count("hivm.hir.load ") == 2
+    assert text.count("hivm.hir.store ") == 2
+    assert "!tt.ptr" not in text and "tensor<" not in text
+    print("IR PASS: subview", case["name"])
+
+
+def _launch(case, seed=7, compile_only=False):
+    dtype = DTYPES[case["dtype"]][1]
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    x = torch.randint(-127, 128, (8, 2064), generator=generator).to(dtype)
+    y = torch.randint(-127, 128, (8, 1040), generator=generator).to(dtype)
+    inputs = (x.npu(), y.npu())
+    out = torch.full((8, 1040), float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device="npu")
+    backing = torch.full_like(inputs[0], float("nan"))
+    offset = 256 if seed == 19 else 128
+    args = (*inputs, out, backing, offset)
+    if compile_only:
+        return subview_alias.warmup(*args, grid=(1, ), **constants(case)), None, None, None
+    kernel = subview_alias[(1, )](*args, **constants(case))
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    expected = x.clone()
+    mode = case["mode"]
+    if mode == "pitched":
+        expected[:, :1040] = y
+    else:
+        start = {"prefix": 0, "static_offset": 128, "dynamic_offset": offset, "nested_offset": offset + 128}[mode]
+        expected.flatten()[start:start + 8320] = y.flatten()
+    return kernel, out.cpu(), backing.cpu(), (y, expected)
+
+
+@matrix(CONFIGS)
+def test_compile(case):
+    kernel, _, _, _ = _launch(case, compile_only=True)
+    check_kernel_binary(kernel)
+
+
+@matrix(CONFIGS)
+def test_run(case):
+    for seed in (7, 19):
+        _, actual, backing, expected = _launch(case, seed)
+        assert torch.equal(actual, expected[0]), "alias load/store changed values"
+        assert torch.equal(backing, expected[1]), "alias addressed the wrong elements or overwrote guards"
+        print("ACCURACY PASS: subview", case["name"], "seed", seed, "exact alias and guard match")
+
+
+def main():
+    do_ir, do_compile, do_run = get_stages()
+    for case in CONFIGS:
+        if do_ir:
+            test_ir(case)
+        if do_compile:
+            test_compile(case)
+        if do_run:
+            test_run(case)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Host-only bounds, layout and offset contracts for TLA buffer views.
+
+Recording builders check Python metadata and rejection behavior. Device and
+real-IR tests live separately in vector/subview.py; these mocks do not stand
+in for compilation or numerical validation.
+"""
+import importlib
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+import triton.language as tl
+
+TLA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "language" / "tla"
+if "view_tla_src" not in sys.modules:
+    package = types.ModuleType("view_tla_src")
+    package.__path__ = [str(TLA_DIR)]
+    sys.modules["view_tla_src"] = package
+view = importlib.import_module("view_tla_src.view")
+
+
+class Handle:
+
+    def __init__(self, value=None):
+        self.value = value
+
+
+class Recorder:
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def get_bf16_ty(self):
+        return "bf16"
+
+    def create_tla_buffer_type(self, shape, dtype, space, strides, offset):
+        return (tuple(shape), dtype, space, tuple(strides), offset)
+
+    def create_tla_subview(self, source, offsets, sizes, strides):
+        self.calls.append(("subview", source, offsets, sizes, strides))
+        return Handle()
+
+    def create_tla_collapse_shape(self, source, result_type, reassociation):
+        self.calls.append(("collapse", source, result_type, reassociation))
+        return Handle()
+
+    def create_tla_expand_shape(self, source, result_type, reassociation):
+        self.calls.append(("expand", source, result_type, reassociation))
+        return Handle()
+
+
+class Semantic:
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.builder = Recorder()
+
+    def to_tensor(self, value):
+        return value if isinstance(value, tl.tensor) else types.SimpleNamespace(handle=Handle(value))
+
+
+def buf(shape=(8, 2064), strides=None, offset=0):
+    return view.buffer(Handle(), view.buffer_type(shape, tl.bfloat16, "ub", strides, offset))
+
+
+def test_subview_preserves_pitch_and_legacy_view_contract():
+    source = buf()
+    explicit = Semantic()
+    legacy = Semantic()
+    sliced = view.subview(source, (0, 0), (8, 1040), _semantic=explicit)
+    compatible = view.view(source, (8, 1040), _semantic=legacy)
+    assert sliced.type == compatible.type
+    assert sliced.shape == (8, 1040) and sliced.strides == (2064, 1)
+    assert sliced.dtype == source.dtype and sliced.space == "ub"
+    assert sliced.offset is None
+    assert explicit.builder.calls[0][0] == legacy.builder.calls[0][0] == "subview"
+
+
+def test_relative_subview_strides():
+    source = buf((16, 16), (32, 1), offset=64)
+    sem = Semantic()
+    sliced = view.subview(source, (1, 2), (4, 8), (2, 1), _semantic=sem)
+    assert sliced.strides == (64, 1)
+    call = sem.builder.calls[0]
+    assert call[1] is source.handle
+    assert [x.value for x in call[2]] == [1, 2]
+    assert call[3:] == ([4, 8], [2, 1])
+
+
+def test_compact_prefix_uses_subview_and_reshape():
+    sem = Semantic()
+    flat = view.reshape(buf(), (16512, ), _semantic=sem)
+    prefix = view.subview(flat, (0, ), (8320, ), _semantic=sem)
+    compact = view.reshape(prefix, (8, 1040), _semantic=sem)
+    assert compact.shape == (8, 1040) and compact.strides == (1040, 1)
+    assert compact.offset is None
+    assert [c[0] for c in sem.builder.calls] == ["collapse", "subview", "expand"]
+    assert sem.builder.calls[-1][2] == ((8, 1040), "bf16", "ub", (1040, 1), None)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("offset", [0, 128, None])
+def test_reshape_preserves_offset_in_every_result_type(offset):
+    sem = Semantic()
+    result = view.reshape(buf((8, 16), offset=offset), (4, 32), _semantic=sem)
+    assert result.offset == offset
+    assert [c[0] for c in sem.builder.calls] == ["collapse", "expand"]
+    assert all(c[2][-1] == offset for c in sem.builder.calls)
+
+
+def test_runtime_offset_is_forwarded_to_subview():
+    sem = Semantic()
+    offset = tl.tensor(Handle(), tl.int32)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("offsets,sizes,strides,reason", [
